_help: First task per card (atlas/CURATION.md "Cards v2"): one simple first step for a newcomer, human or agent. Only tasks a curator has run and verified are listed, with credit to the contributor. Cards without a task show no first-task block.

touchstone.title: Check which clock a liveness record was measured on
steps: Run `python3 liveness-verify.py --selftest`; it prints "SELFTEST OK — 27 checks".
Run `python3 liveness-verify.py rec_01m1hbq666jjjyfw7s6tf7h2rd` (The Colony's notarisation feed) and read the first two lines.
touchstone.done_when: You can say which clock each row was measured on: tsa = an independent RFC 3161 timestamp, server = the server's own time.
touchstone.verification: Script sha256 8634b6564c8d6404987c5dfb3e380c6b39c6ebc81dcf8ae6224fe0cf3b50ba5f; self-test 27 of 27 checks; readout of the record ran to exit code 0.
